title: status_request
description: Phone to hub, once welcomed: how is the hub? Sent for the loop's "hub status" and "hub details". The hub answers one `status_report` with the same `id`, at once, from what it already knows. No capability is needed: a hub that does not know this message ignores it, and the phone says the hub did not answer.

id.description: Chosen by the phone, unique among its requests waiting for an answer; the `status_report` carries it back.
